description: This header file declares functions related to manipulating Android boot images and vendor boot images, including repacking, unpacking, and reading Android version information.

methods.name: RepackBootImage
methods.description: Repack a boot image with a new kernel, producing a new boot image file.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImage
methods.description: Repack a vendor boot image, possibly with a new ramdisk.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImageWithEmptyRamdisk
methods.description: Repack a vendor boot image with an empty ramdisk.

methods.name: UnpackBootImage
methods.description: Unpack a boot image into a specified directory.

methods.name: UnpackVendorBootImageIfNotUnpacked
methods.description: Check if the vendor boot image has been unpacked; if not, unpack it.

methods.name: RepackGem5BootImage
methods.description: Repack a Gem5 emulator boot image with provided initrd and bootconfig.

methods.name: ReadAndroidVersionFromBootImage
methods.description: Extract the Android version from a boot image.

methods.name: UnpackRamdisk
methods.description: Unpack a ramdisk image into a directory.

methods.name: PackRamdisk
methods.description: Pack a ramdisk directory into a ramdisk image.
